site_hero.title: Who carries non-firm power risk — and who is prepared to underwrite it.
site_hero.lede: Britain is reconnecting industry to a network that cannot promise firm power at queue speed. This index scores carriers, MGAs, brokers, assets and reinsurers on Exposure and Preparedness — and reduces each to a Margin of Safety the market does not yet publish.

objection_faq.q: Isn't this just a climate or catastrophe peril?
objection_faq.a: No — the trigger is lawful switch-off under connection terms, not weather. Damage-BI and cat models price the wrong event; NFRI scores who carries interruptible-power exposure and who has the data, product and capital to underwrite it.

objection_faq.q: Why should I trust outside-in research scores?
objection_faq.a: Every sub-factor fuses register and filing evidence with research prior by credibility weight. Measured share and the L5 publication gate are printed on every build — PROVISIONAL until the blend clears 60%.

objection_faq.q: Does Margin of Safety replace underwriting judgment?
objection_faq.a: It compresses two axes the market does not publish together into one directional number. It is an index for discovery and relative placement — not an audited rating or investment advice.
